notes.title: I, Gladiator Update is Now Live
notes.content:
The patch has been pushed live that should address issues with save data loss. You also get to save your Steam Achievements even after character's reset.
We also seriously improved awards for winning battles in multiplayer. Now you receive TWICE AS MANY boosters for being victorious in T-Based Multiplayer, as well as receiving boosters and gold for each victory in Hot Sandals mode.
Also, we introduced more awards by giving you gold and denarii  for completing Laurel Challenges in Singleplayer mode.
We also introduced Ping indicator, so it would be easier for you to see if bad connection is affecting your gameplay experience.

Lots of new goodies, what are you waiting for, glads? Grab your swords, arena awaits!

notes.title: I, Gladiator Update is Out
notes.content:
Gladiators, sharpen your swords and stay tuned!!!

The new update has some critical fixes of crashes and lags.

What's new:

- Game does not switch to Korean, Brazilian-Portuguese, Chinese - FIXED
- Avatars of Steam players are shown in the game - ADDED
- Player can't do anything after the Disconnection Error - FIXED
- Blocking sometimes doesn't work - FIXED
- After the player recovers from the knockdown, his attack has a slow response - FIXED 
- Game crashes when the player achieves the 2nd level of the Hall of Fame and presses OK on the message board - FIXED
- Games crashes after the Disconnection Error - FIXED
- Other bugfixing

notes.title: I, Gladiator Update - Coming Soon
notes.content:
Thanks a lot, guys, for all your comments and notices in the Steam community!!!
We would like you to enjoy our game! As we did make I, Gladiator for you!
We permanently read your comments, and we hear everyone! 


Below are the list of the things we are going to have in our nearest update.

- Game does not switch to Korean, Brazilian-Portuguese, Chinese - FIXED
- Avatars of Steam players are shown in the game - ADDED
- Player can't do anything after the Disconnection Error - FIXED
- Blocking sometimes doesn't work - FIXED
- After the player recovers from the knockdown, his attack has a slow response - FIXED 
- Player can't use the hyphen in his email and password during the registration - FIXED
- Game crashes when the player achieves the 2nd level of the Hall of Fame and presses OK on the message board - FIXED
- Games crashes after the Disconnection Error - FIXED
- Other bugfixing
